title: Truck Mods Worth the Money in 2026: Bed Covers, Tires, Lifts (And the Warranty Myth)
description:
Fifteen billion dollars. That is how much Americans spent modifying their pickups in a single year, according to SEMA. Nearly thirteen million trucks got new parts. Lift kits, giant tires, bed covers, lights. Some of those upgrades make a truck better and even save money. Others quietly cost their owners thousands, every year, for as long as they own the truck.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
